atAGlance: Sinh tố rau má blends pennywort into a thicker green drink, cooling and grassy but softer than straight rau má juice.
whatItIs: Sinh tố rau má is rau má blended into a cold drink, sometimes creamy. Expect pennywort smoothie that is green, herbal, grassy, and often softened with milk or mung bean.
howToEnjoy: Order it when you want something earthy and cooling instead of fruity.
howLocalsOrder: Sinh tố rau má is earthy and green, especially if mung bean is added. Ask less sweet and no milk if you want the pennywort flavor clean instead of dessert-like.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Sinh tố rau má shows Vietnam’s herbal refreshment lane, where leafy drinks can be as common as fruit drinks.
goodToKnow: The grassy flavor can surprise first-timers.
